items.title: Bengaluru man throws acid on wife, brutally attacks her with knife in full public view
items.summary: Madhumitha, a 26-year-old nurse, had stepped out of the clinic for breakfast on Thursday, September 17, when her husband chased her down, attacked her with a butcher knife and poured acid on her. The attack took place in full public view around 9.15 am near Narayana Clinic in Bengaluru’s JP Nagar. Madhumitha is currently undergoing treatment at a private hospital. She is in a critical condition, according to the police. Madhumitha, who hails from Kolkata, has been working at the clinic for around one-and-a-half years. According to sources, Madhumitha and Venkatesh were married in 2023 and had been living separately for the past year due to family disputes. The alleged attack is suspected to have followed marital differences between the couple. Venkatesh had arrived at the clinic on a motorcycle carrying a knife, a machete and acid. Madhumitha had reportedly stepped out of the clinic to have breakfast at around 9.15 am when he followed her. She reached the hospital parking area while shouting for help, where the accused repeatedly attacked her with a machete and another sharp weapon before pouring floor-cleaning acid on her. items.title: Easy Birthday Cake Ideas for Outdoor Parties
items.summary: Outdoor birthday parties come with a problem indoor ones don't have to deal with, heat, wind, and the very real risk of a beautifully frosted cake turning into a puddle before anyone's had a slice. Picking the right cake format matters just as much as picking the flavour when the celebration is happening in a garden, a park, or under a tent rather than a climate-controlled living room. The good news is that being outdoors-friendly doesn't have to mean boring. A few smart format choices can hold up in warmer weather while still looking festive enough for photos. If you're browsing options and want something specifically built for a child's celebration, a solid birthday cake for kids range usually includes a few formats that travel and hold up well outdoors, which is worth checking before settling on a design purely based on looks.
